section.name: Subject-wide Syllabus
section.notes: Complete 27-topic Ancient History repository syllabus in source order. Basic/canonical owners are taught first, verified practice follows, Advanced owners remain optional enrichment, and all outputs use the separate section notes/workbooks/indexes convention.
